The huge US state of Alaska boasts some of the world's most deadly weather, with temperatures regularly plummeting to a lethal -80 Fahrenheit, freezing exposed limbs in minutes. The Audi RS6 Avant isn't a boring whip at all, seeing that Audi's Quattro GmbH get an output of 560hp out of the 4.2-liter V8 engine. But tuning company Meyer isn't satisfied enough. They turn the RS6 into the RS6 R Clubsport with an output of 811 hp and a sound similar to the rumble of thunder. The 'White Wolf' is visually aggressive as well. Stefan Kalläne is the man behind the extremely tuned Volkswagen Lupo. At the Tuning Expo in Saarbrücken he looks for the hottest gadgets of the tuning scene. Whether they are brutal, funny, useful or just very stylish - there is guaranteed to be something for everyone.
They are sleek, they are exclusive and most of all: they are extremely fast - supercars! See the first Arabian supercar and many other brand new luxury sport cars from the Qatar Motor Show.

Audi's economic situation is tense. Costs must come down - profits must go up. And as one of the best-selling models, the success of the new Q3 has a major impact on the future of the Bavarian brand. We attended the world premiere, took a seat in the new compact SUV and spoke to experts.

Australian Circuit Boat Racing offers high-speed thrills on the water, where precision and speed decide intense races on demanding courses. Spectacular competitions captivate motorsport fans across Australia.

The New Zealand Jetsprint Championship is the most important sprint boat competition from New Zealand, the country where the sport was founded in 1981. Jetsprinting is comparable to rally sports, but there is only one boat on the track at any given time and boats drive at very high speeds. The up to 500 HP strong jet sprint boats therefore try to achieve the best time on the tracks.

Caution, danger of splashing! Since 1992, the Aquabike World Championship has been the most important racing series in the sport of jet skiing and one of the fastest competitions in water sports. On specially designed race courses or on the high seas, the participants engage in thrilling races in the ski and runabout categories and fascinate with all kinds of stunts on their more than 300 hp jet skis.
The AquaX Championship is an US-based jet-ski series where competitors race in the sprint or enduro category

Tuning is back at BSG Racing. For weeks Dirk Hattenhauer and his crew have been working on the refurbishment of an old Opel Kadett. Their goal is to turn the car into the most spectacular custom car that the European tuning scene has ever seen. They have only six days left until presentation, but there is still work to do. Will the boys finish the car in time?

The McLaren 720S Spider is the fastest convertible in the world. Its cheeky sound is anything but a posh British accent. It’s the voice of an uncompromising driving machine with a high potential for addiction. Jaguar, on the other hand, presents itself as majestic. But on the back seat of the F-Pace SVR in sports mode, the Queen would probably feel sick. We also check whether the Porsche Cayenne Coupé can justify its extra price compared to the Cayenne.

Size matters! At least many families would agree with that. With the BMW XM, BMW's M division is treating itself to a true colossus for families with certain expectations on its 50th anniversary. Much quieter, but equally imposing in appearance, the fully electric KIA EV9 enters the scene. In our family check, we find out if it might just be the best electric car for large families.

Kio ja sen veljet ovat astuneet uuteen vaaralliseen maailmaan. Nuorimpana Kio on kaikkein haavoittuvaisimmassa asemassa. Kun se löytää rehevän suoalueen, jossa on runsaasti saaliseläimiä ja naarasleijonien lauma, veljekset vaikuttavat löytäneen uuden kotinsa. Tällä suomaalla on kuitenkin jo omat kuninkaansa. Yhdessä ne kohtaavat joukon koettelemuksia puhvelimetsästyksestä yhteenottoihin kilpailevien urosten kanssa, mikä muovaa niiden välille murtumattoman siteen. Kaatuuko Kio vai lunastaako se paikkansa kuninkaana?
